title: Competence-Aware Orchestration for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.13144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing complex reasoning through role specialization and collaboration, yet a key challenge remains: how can collaboration be adapted to a backbone's competence on the current query? This problem matters because more collaboration is not always better--richer coordination may help on difficult cases, but it also incurs additional token cost and redundant interactions. We propose a two-stage competence-aware framework for automatic MAS orchestration. It first models the LLM backbone's task-conditioned competence for the current query, and then uses this signal to adapt role activation and the communication graph. translated_title: 面向基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的能力感知编排
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）已成为通过角色专业化与协作来增强复杂推理能力的一种有前景的范式，但一个关键挑战仍然存在：如何使协作适配骨干模型在当前查询上的能力水平？这个问题之所以重要，是因为更多的协作并不总是更好——更丰富的协调可能有助于困难案例，但也会带来额外的 token 成本和冗余交互。我们提出了一个用于自动 MAS 编排的两阶段能力感知框架。该框架首先对大语言模型骨干在当前查询上的任务条件化能力进行建模，然后利用这一信号来调整角色激活和通信图。在六个基准测试上，我们的方法取得了平均 93.81% 的得分。使用六个能力水平各异的大语言模型骨干进行的实验进一步表明，我们的方法能够根据推断出的能力来调整协作：对于能力较高的骨干……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种两阶段能力感知编排框架，通过建模大语言模型骨干在当前查询上的能力，自适应地调整多智能体系统中的角色激活与通信图，在六个基准测试上取得平均93.81%的成绩。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage competence-aware orchestration framework that models the LLM backbone's competence on the current query to adaptively adjust role activation and the communication graph in multi-agent systems, achieving an average score of 93.81% across six benchmarks.
